description: Estimate the USD cost of a request from token counts and the live catalog prices, with the API's billing formula: (input - cached) × input price + cached × cached-input price + output × output price, per 1M tokens, rounded up to $0.000001. You supply the token counts: this server has no tokenizer, so the result is an estimate. Reasoning tokens are output tokens. To see the most a chat call can cost, pass its max_tokens as output_tokens. No API key needed.

cached_input_tokens.description: How many of input_tokens are read from the prompt cache. Default 0.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Default glm-5.3-flash-abliterated.

priority.description: Use the priority-tier prices (service_tier "priority"). Default false.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate AbliteratedLLM request cost
